_comment: Deterministic transcripts used by both agent runners to enable apples-to-apples comparison. Each scenario sets state via tool calls, then asks for recipe ideas. The 'expected' block lists invariants the final state must satisfy — exact recipe titles are LLM-discretion and are NOT asserted.
